response.description:
Teams running GPU‑backed
workloads often lack integrated visibility into GPU utilization alongside
Kubernetes metrics. AKS managed GPU metrics automatically expose performance
and utilization data from NVIDIA GPU‑enabled node pools into managed Prometheus
and Grafana environments. This brings GPU telemetry into the same observability
stack as cluster metrics, supporting capacity planning and operational
monitoring without manual exporter setup.Learn more.
response.title: Public Preview: AKS managed GPU metrics in Azure Monitor
